label: CARD-NLR system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a CARD-NLR locus represented by the DefenseFinder CARD_NLR model namespace, coupling bacterial CARD-like detector components and NLR-like profiles to subtype-specific GasderMIN, endonuclease, Trypsin_Phospho, or Subtilase effector profiles that can promote cell death after phage recognition.
observations: CARD-NLR branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual bacterial CARD-like domains, NLR profiles, GasderMIN proteins, GasderMIN system contexts, endonuclease effector profiles, CARD_NLR_Phospho effector profiles, Subtilase effector profiles, CARD-dependent gasdermin activation, effector-mediated cell death, source database rows naming one CARD_NLR model, and other bacterial phage-defense systems.
